title: How can I cancel/reschedule/class upgrade/add child with my flight?
bullets: What can I do if the flight schedule has changed/been canceled by the airline?
Kindly submit your flight "Date Change" request from your "
" option by selecting your required booking menu and share your requirement in "Remarks" so that we can share all the details as per your request to your login email address.
You can also communicate through our hotline number +88 09678 332211
If flight is rescheduled by the airline, will i get full refund?

Generally if the flight reschedule time is within 30-45 minutes, airlines don’t provide full refund. For higher time, you can claim full refund. We’ll communicate with the airline and share an update to your registered email address. If the airline initiates full refund, we’ll share the refund initiation confirmation. If the airline shares a quotation, we’ll share the quotation to your email accordingly and you need to provide confirmation to the email reply.
How can I Reschedule/Cancel my flight from your platform by my own?
Please submit your flight "Date Change/Cancellation" request from your "Bookings" option by selecting your required booking menu.
For scheduling, share your new preferred date and time in "Remarks" so that we can share all the details as per your request to your login email address.

For cancellation, if a cancellation fee appears, you can review and confirm the cancellation there. If no fee is displayed, our team will send a detailed breakdown of any applicable charges to your registered email address.
Why can’t I pay for a pending flight booking?

It is not possible to pay for pending bookings as the status gets updated in the system in real-time. Hence, you will have to book again and complete the payment in a single attempt, within the allotted 20 mins time.

title: Why can't I find flights on your platform?
bullets: We don't have any flights in our inventory for your preferred travel destination and timeline.
How to keep my booking on hold to make the payment by tomorrow?
Prices of air tickets are not fixed and can change anytime. So, we cannot keep a booking unless you confirm it by making full payment.
How can I find my flight ticket?
We will email the ticket to your given contact email address or you can also download the flight ticket from your “My Booking” menu.
How can I request for VIP/Wheelchair/Passport Update?
To add your request, kindly contact with us with your booking ID through our email/hotline/messenger so that we can share the details with our Fulfilment team to assist you accordingly.
Seat/meal can be selected from airline manage booking/web check-in option, charge can be applied as per airline policy.
How can I add baggage to my flight ticket?

For domestic flight, additional baggage needs to be purchase from airline counter and for international flight, You can add additional baggage directly from the airline's website through the manage booking option or at the airport counter. Additional changes may be required as per the airline's policy.
How can I check my flight details?
To check your flight details, please visit airline website and through manage booking menu, you can easily check your flight details.

title: Why can’t I book the flight on your platform?
bullets: For child age mismatch, for international flight (British Airways), flight is actually not available but for the syncing issue its showing on our platform but it is not possible to book. Kindly select a different option.
Is it possible to make the payment in partial payment methods?
Currently, it’s not possible to book with partial payment methods. As you need to make the payment under a single transaction with a single payment method.
Why didn’t I get a discount?

The discount is already applied in our system. When you search on our website or app the best discounted price as well as the regular price will be shown. However, the discount may be different depending on your payment method. Please select your preferred flight and go to the next page where you can select your preferred payment method. From there you can enter bKash/nagad or your bank's bin number (first 6 digits) to verify the discount.
Why am I unable to make the payment?
The payment gateway is strictly operated by the bank side so if you are facing any payment issue, kindly communicate with your relevant bank.
How to change/correct a traveler's name?

Generally, airlines do not allow changing or rectifying travelers' names. You can place your request by contacting with us with your booking ID through our email/hotline/messenger so that we can share the details with our relevant team (FF) to assist you accordingly.

title: Is it possible to book a flight by physically visiting your office?
bullets: You can book a flight by visiting our customer experience center but you may not get the discount offers that are applicable for the online booking.
Why the passport expiry date can’t be selected?

As per Bangladesh Passport Authority, passport validity should have remained at least 6 months before your journey date. Otherwise, you won't be able to fly out of country. You can purchase the flight ticket now with your old passport modifying the passport validity date, but you need to reissue your passport to extend your passport validity and you also need to share your new passport with us to update with your flight booking.
What is the flight refund policy?

Refunds will be initiated (if applicable) after a successful cancellation. The refund will be sent through the same channel that the traveler has used for payment. Depending on the channel type, the payment may take 1-5 working days to be reflected in the account.
Charged by GoZayaan & it's non-refundable. It might change based on payment method.
Can I book a flight without Visa?
Yes, you won’t be need to share the visa copy with us. However to avoid an immigration related issue, we already recommended book a round-way flight for tourist visa.

US /Canada / Australia / Japan / Korea / Shenzhen / UK/ New Zealand visa holders: Arrival and departure HKG must be within the same calendar day or maximum of 12 hours in case of different calendar days.otherwise they will required HKG transit visa.
And for Rest of the country will be required HKG transit visa and visiting country's visa

title: Flight FAQ’s
bullets: Why the booking got failed thought the payment has been deducted from my balance?
Kindly share your flight booking ID and transaction details so that we can check that have we received the payment or not also, if we received the payment, should we issue the ticket.
Is there any restriction from the airline to have round-way flight under same PNR?
Some airlines require both route flights under same airlines. For example:

(TG): Passengers traveling with Visitor/Tourist visas or e-VISAs to ASEAN countries for tourism purposes, especially from DAC to HAN, SGN, PNH, SAI, VTE, RGN, KUL, PEN, and SIN must have a single round-trip ticket issued for the above routes. No separate tickets on TG or any other airline will be accepted at check-in.
(SV): Must book round segment under the same PNR.

(OD): Traveling to Pakistan, Maldives, Uzbekistan, and ASEAN destinations on Batik Air with visitor/tourist visa or e-Visa: Passengers must have a single round-trip ticket with Batik Air. Separate PNRs or tickets with other airlines will not be accepted at check-in.
(BS): Passengers must have a single round-trip ticket. No separate tickets on BS or any other airline will be accepted at check-in.
For other airlines, the requirement can vary based on the visa type. So we recommend to communicate with the embassy for further assistance.

title: Flight FAQ’s
bullets: EK (Emirates): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa must have a round-trip ticket booked on the same airline under the same PNR. Tickets on different airlines will not be accepted for boarding.

BS (US Bangla): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa must have a round-trip ticket booked on the same airline for the same origin and return airport (Dhaka to Dubai and Dubai to Dhaka). Tickets on different airlines or for different departure/arrival airports will not be accepted for boarding.

WY (Oman Air): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa must have a round-trip ticket booked on the same airline for the same origin and return airport (Dhaka to Dubai and Dubai to Dhaka). Tickets on different airlines or for different departure/arrival airports will not be accepted for boarding.
QR (Qatar airways): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa must have a round-trip ticket booked on the same airline. Tickets on different airlines will not be accepted for boarding.
GF (Gulf Air): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa have the option to purchase a one-way ticket. However, they must present a return ticket, which can be with a different airline.
6E (Indigo): Travelers flying to the UAE on a tourist or visit visa have the option to purchase a one-way ticket. However, they must present a return ticket, which can be with a different airline.

title: Gift Card FAQs
bullets: What is the GoZayaan Gift Card?
The GoZayaan Gift Card is a product that can be purchased from the GoZayaan Platform and redeemed as a coupon for Flight, Hotel and Tour Products.
How do you send the Gift Card?

This gift card can be sent to other people as well. Inside the details section, you can select for someone else. Simply input their email address, the message you want to send and when you want to send it. Complete the purchase and the gift card will be sent accordingly.
How many Gift Cards can you use per booking?
Only one gift card can be used per booking.
How do you redeem the Gift Card?

The gift card can be redeemed in the coupons section. Just input the code in your gift card in the coupon input field and hit apply. The gift card coupon will be applied and your price will reflect the gift card value. Do note that the gift card coupons are not clubbable with other discounts.
What if the final amount is larger than the Gift Card Value?
If the final amount is larger than the gift card value, the user who is purchasing the product will have to pay the additional amount in the purchase journey similar to if they had used a coupon.
What if the final amount is smaller than the Gift Card Value?

If the final amount is smaller than the gift card value, the user will have to pay a negligible transaction fee to complete the purchase. However the rest of the amount won't be refunded and will be lost. A single gift card coupon is only redeemable once.

title: Terms and Conditions
bullets: Any individual can buy up to maximum 6 gift cards in a single transaction
The minimum purchase value is 500 BDT and maximum is 100,000 BDT
1 year from the date of purchase (If unscheduled/Purchased for oneself)
1 year from the scheduled date (If purchased for someone else and scheduled)
The gift card can be scheduled for up to 6 months from the date of purchase.
The card is only redeemable once and any amount left will not be carried over or stored.
Any booking made using the gift card is non-refundable.
Any number of Gift cards can be used to purchase on GoZayaan's platform.

In the event of the gift card code being unwillingly shared or stolen, only the user who purchased the gift card can request a change of the code and if it is redeemed before it could be canceled, GoZayaan shall bear no responsibility.

If there is any involuntary cancellation of the user's desired product at no fault of the user before the user could avail of it, GoZayaan will issue another gift card of the same value to the user. This issuance will be against the account which was used to redeem the gift card and not the purchaser.

Gift cards can only be used for online transactions. If a customer visits our Experience Center to make a purchase using the gift card, our Experience Center executives will assist them in completing the purchase online.

GoZayaan reserves the right to modify the status of any gift card, including but not limited to voiding, suspending, or canceling it, if any fraudulent, improper, or criminal activity is suspected at any stage of the booking and/or purchase process. This action may be taken at GoZayaan’s sole discretion without prior notice to the user.
